svg.title: Microsoft Foundry Agent Service workshop architecture
svg.desc: Azure architecture diagram for a portal-first workshop. A participant and GitHub Codespaces access an existing Azure resource group. The resource group contains a Microsoft Foundry account and project, Azure AI Search, Azure Container Apps, Application Insights, and Log Analytics. Prompt and hosted agents use model deployments, Foundry IQ, a toolbox, and synthetic data through public endpoints secured with Microsoft Entra ID and Azure RBAC.
svg.text: Microsoft Foundry Agent Service ハンズオン構成
Portal と Notebook から、既存の Azure Resource Group に構築する keyless architecture

g.text: Microsoft Entra ID + Azure RBAC · synthetic data only

svg.text: participant-owned · setup does not create or delete the group

g.text: Agent, knowledge, tools, evaluation, and optimization
